## Audit Brief — Synthetic Fixture for Prompt-Cache Integration Test

### Section 1: Synthetic Pass Context

The prompt-prefix-cache test fixture intentionally includes representative repo-context content to model the size of a real audit-brief preamble. Each section is approximately 250 chars, and we include 32 sections to comfortably exceed OpenAI's 1024-token (~4096 char) minimum threshold for prefix caching. This ensures the cache eligibility decision in shouldSeedCache() returns true.

Key invariant under test: when two requests share the byte-identical prefix from message #0 (system) through message #1 (this brief + plan + file-list), OpenAI's auto-caching layer charges the cached_tokens-discounted rate on the shared portion of the second call. cached_tokens > 0 on call N+1 is the success signal.
